description: Structured eval definitions for the CloudWatch Application Signals Operator. Five-case proven set exercising the OPERATION_COMPLETED / REVIEW_REQUIRED classification across Application Signals topologies (SLO creation with MWMBR burn rate alerts, SLI metrics for latency/availability auto-derived from traces, service map with X-Ray correlation and RUM integration, multi-service SLO tracking with fleet dashboard, missing OTel instrumentation). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Enable SLOs with MWMBR burn rate alerts for a critical payments service
eval_cases.branch: OPERATION_COMPLETED — 99.9% availability SLO, 30-day rolling interval, MWMBR fast burn (5m/1h, 14.4x → page) + slow burn (30m/6h, 6.0x → ticket), auto-derived SLI metrics
eval_cases.prompt: Enable Application Signals for service payments-api, operation POST /charge. Create an SLO with 99.9% availability target over 30-day rolling interval. Warning threshold 99.95%. Configure MWMBR burn rate alerts: fast burn (5m/1h, 14.4x) pages SNS topic critical-alerts, slow burn (30m/6h, 6.0x) tickets SNS topic warning-tickets. OTel SDK instrumentation already enabled. Tags: Environment=production, Team=payments, Tier=critical.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APP_SIGNALS: payments-api (POST-/charge)
VERDICT: OPERATION_COMPLETED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] OTel instrumentation: enabled (SDK)
  [✓] Service discovered: payments-api
  [✓] SLI metrics: availability + latency (auto-derived)
  [✓] SLO: payments-api-charge-availability (target 99.9%, interval 30 days rolling)
  [✓] Burn rate alerts: fast burn (5m/1h, 14.4x → page) + slow burn (30m/6h, 6.0x → ticket)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws application-signals list-service-level-objectives

eval_cases.name: Verify auto-derived SLI metrics for latency and availability with anomaly detection
eval_cases.branch: OPERATION_COMPLETED — SLI auto-derivation from traces, operation-level latency targets (P99), anomaly detection on latency, availability SLI
eval_cases.prompt: Verify SLI metrics for service checkout-api. Operations: GET /cart, POST /checkout, GET /order-status. Need latency SLI (P99 < 500ms for POST /checkout, P99 < 200ms for GET endpoints) and availability SLI (99.95% all operations). Enable anomaly detection on latency P99. OTel auto-instrumentation via CloudWatch Agent is configured. Tags: Environment=production, Team=checkout.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APP_SIGNALS: checkout-api (service-level)
VERDICT: OPERATION_COMPLETED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] SLI metrics: availability + latency (auto-derived from traces)
  [✓] Operation-level targets: POST /checkout P99 < 500ms, GET P99 < 200ms
  [✓] Anomaly detection: enabled on latency P99

eval_cases.name: Service map visualization with X-Ray correlation and RUM integration
eval_cases.branch: OPERATION_COMPLETED — service map auto-generated from traces, X-Ray drill-down enabled, RUM correlated via trace IDs, end-to-end observability
eval_cases.prompt: Verify service map and trace correlation for the microservices architecture: frontend (RUM enabled), api-gateway, orders-api, inventory-api, payments-api. Need X-Ray drill-down from SLO status to individual traces. RUM app monitor storefront-rum with EnableXRay true. All services have OTel SDK instrumentation. Tags: Environment=production, Team=platform.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APP_SIGNALS: storefront (service-level)
VERDICT: OPERATION_COMPLETED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Service map: auto-generated (5 services, edges from trace context)
  [✓] X-Ray correlation: drill-down enabled from SLO to traces
  [✓] RUM integration: storefront-rum (EnableXRay: true)

eval_cases.name: Multi-service SLO tracking with fleet dashboard and canary alarms
eval_cases.branch: OPERATION_COMPLETED — 5 services with per-service SLOs, aggregated CloudWatch dashboard, canary alarms, fast-burn alerts per service
eval_cases.prompt: Create multi-service SLO tracking for 5 services: orders-api, inventory-api, payments-api, shipping-api, notification-api. Each needs a 99.9% availability SLO over 30-day rolling interval. Create a CloudWatch dashboard aggregating all SLO statuses. Configure fast-burn burn rate alerts for each service to SNS topic critical-alerts. Add canary alarms for each service endpoint. All services have OTel instrumentation. Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APP_SIGNALS: multi-service (5 services)
VERDICT: OPERATION_COMPLETED
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Per-service SLOs: 5 SLOs (99.9% availability, 30-day rolling)
  [✓] Fleet dashboard: CloudWatch dashboard aggregating all SLO statuses
  [✓] Burn rate alerts: fast burn per service → SNS critical-alerts
  [✓] Canary alarms: per-service endpoint canaries

eval_cases.name: Application Signals requested without OTel instrumentation
eval_cases.branch: REVIEW_REQUIRED — service has no OTel SDK instrumentation and CloudWatch Agent not configured; Application Signals cannot discover services without traces
eval_cases.prompt: Enable Application Signals for service legacy-api. Create an SLO with 99.5% availability target. Configure burn rate alerts. The service has no OTel SDK instrumentation and CloudWatch Agent is not configured for auto-instrumentation. Tags: Environment=staging.
eval_cases.expected_output:
APP_SIGNALS: legacy-api (service-level)
VERDICT: REVIEW_REQUIRED
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] OTel instrumentation: MISSING — no SDK instrumentation and CloudWatch Agent not configured; Application Signals cannot discover services or derive SLI metrics without traces
